title: Efficient synthesis, dual anti-tubercular and antioxidant activity of triazole-acetophenone derivatives: enhanced efficacy via esterification and quantum mechanical validation of CYP121 binding
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3609-3622
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09368F, Paper

Rahul A. Jagtap, Bapu S. Jagdale, Sunil L. Dhonnar, Samin A. Shaikh, Rahul A. More, Rajasekhar Reddy Alavala, Ghazala Muteeb, Dennys Fernandez-Conde, Tushar Janardan Pawar, Rohan J. Meshram, Jesica Escobar-Cabrera, Santosh S. Chobe
Twelve novel triazole-based acetophenone derivatives (3a–3f, 4a–4f) synthesized via catalyst-free cycloaddition integrate a CYP121 inhibiting scaffold with dual anti-tubercular and antioxidant properties.
